question: How is the divine both contemplative and sovereign abode of all beings?
premises: The divine is addressed as contemplative.
The divine is addressed as the abode of beings.
The divine is addressed as the lord of beings.
inference: The divine unites contemplative awareness with being the dwelling and lord of all beings.
plain_english: Obeisance to the contemplative one, obeisance to the abode of beings, obeisance to the lord of beings.
